'''Splash!! The Return of the Two Pokémon''' (Japanese: '''ザブザブ！！帰ってきた2匹''' ''Splash!! Those Two Have Returned'') is the 28th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Leon]], the [[Gym Leader]]s, and the {{tc|Gym Challenger}}s battle {{p|Eternatus}}.
* {{Casey}} finds her {{p|Falinks}}, Giga, and {{p|Stunfisk}}, Mega.
* Giga and Mega give {{Henry}} the [[Rusted Sword]] and [[Rusted Shield|Shield]].
